prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a seamless tileable base-color/albedo texture for painted plaster walls in a tactical first-person game. Create one square 1024x1024 image representing exactly one metre by one metre of calm warm off-white painted plaster. Orthographic straight-on surface scan, evenly lit neutral diffuse illumination, no baked directional lighting, no ambient occlusion, no gradients or vignette. Fine shallow plaster grain and tiny low-contrast irregularities; slight natural age only, clean and believable occupied residential wall. Keep the overall color near warm chalk white, with very restrained fine variation. Continuous seamless repetition on all four edges. Texture fills the entire image. No cracks, large stains, brown blotches, peeling patches, bricks, seams, grooves, objects, text, borders or watermark. This is a texture map, not a picture of a room or a material preview sphere.
